about: MCP servers an agent might use alongside this one, beyond the estate domains in federation.json. Estate servers are the owner's own. Candidates are public servers found in searches; they are listed for review only, are not endorsed, and none is called by this server. A candidate becomes listed only when the owner approves it.

estate.title: DCAT-AP-UK MCP server
estate.description: Read the proposed DCAT-AP-UK profile, and check, score, convert and export metadata records, including converting an OpenAPI description into a data service record. Reads only the generated profile; makes no network requests.

candidates.title: UK legal research MCP server
candidates.description: Case law, legislation, Parliament, bills, votes, committees, citations and HMRC sources through one connection; the publisher states it is read-only.
candidates.status: candidate, awaiting owner review; not endorsed

candidates.title: gb-eli-mcp (legislation.gov.uk)
candidates.description: Legislation.gov.uk, case law and GOV.UK tribunal decisions with persistent identifiers and source links, according to its publisher.
candidates.status: candidate, awaiting owner review; not endorsed
